commands.probe: sh -c 'if [ -z "$SHELL" ] || [ ! -x "$SHELL" ]; then echo "Codex remote SSH requires SHELL to point to an executable login shell" >&2; exit 127; fi; CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD="$1"; export CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD; case "${SHELL##*/}" in csh|tcsh) exec "$SHELL" -i -c '\''set loginsh=1; if ( -r /etc/csh.login ) source /etc/csh.login; if ( -r ~/.login ) source ~/.login; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; nu) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c $env.CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD'\'' ;; fish|xonsh) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; *) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; export CODEX_HOME; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; esac' sh 'printf '\''%b'\'' '\''\217\213\366\312\023\172\275\310'\''; PATH="${CODEX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH"; export PATH; if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exit 86'
commands.version: sh -c 'if [ -z "$SHELL" ] || [ ! -x "$SHELL" ]; then echo "Codex remote SSH requires SHELL to point to an executable login shell" >&2; exit 127; fi; CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD="$1"; export CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD; case "${SHELL##*/}" in csh|tcsh) exec "$SHELL" -i -c '\''set loginsh=1; if ( -r /etc/csh.login ) source /etc/csh.login; if ( -r ~/.login ) source ~/.login; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; nu) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c $env.CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD'\'' ;; fish|xonsh) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; *) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; export CODEX_HOME; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; esac' sh 'printf '\''%b'\'' '\''\240\326\373\013\125\262\350\217'\''; PATH="${CODEX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH"; export PATH; codex --version'
commands.boot: sh -c 'if [ -z "$SHELL" ] || [ ! -x "$SHELL" ]; then echo "Codex remote SSH requires SHELL to point to an executable login shell" >&2; exit 127; fi; CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD="$1"; export CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD; case "${SHELL##*/}" in csh|tcsh) exec "$SHELL" -i -c '\''set loginsh=1; if ( -r /etc/csh.login ) source /etc/csh.login; if ( -r ~/.login ) source ~/.login; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; nu) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c $env.CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD'\'' ;; fish|xonsh) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; *) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; export CODEX_HOME; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; esac' sh 'printf '\''%b'\'' '\''\231\353\244\054\032\037\045\222'\''; PATH="${CODEX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH"; export PATH; if [ "${CODEX_SSH_SKIP_APP_SERVER_BOOT:-}" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; (umask 077; mkdir -p -- "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control" && (pkill -9 -U "$(id -u)" -f '\''codex.*[d]esktop-ssh-websocket-v0.sock'\'' || true) && if [ -S "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK:-}" ]; then ln -sfn -- "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock"; elif [ ! -S "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock" ]; then rm -f -- "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock"; fi && : >"${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/app-server.log") && { SSH_AUTH_SOCK="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock" nohup codex -c features.code_mode_host=true app-server --listen unix:// </dev/null >"${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/app-server.log" 2>&1 & }'
commands.proxy: sh -c 'if [ -z "$SHELL" ] || [ ! -x "$SHELL" ]; then echo "Codex remote SSH requires SHELL to point to an executable login shell" >&2; exit 127; fi; CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD="$1"; export CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD; case "${SHELL##*/}" in csh|tcsh) exec "$SHELL" -i -c '\''set loginsh=1; if ( -r /etc/csh.login ) source /etc/csh.login; if ( -r ~/.login ) source ~/.login; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; nu) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c $env.CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD'\'' ;; fish|xonsh) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; *) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; export CODEX_HOME; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; esac' sh 'printf '\''%b'\'' '\''\072\001\352\256\065\275\372\140'\''; PATH="${CODEX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}:$PATH"; export PATH; if [ -S "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK:-}" ]; then ln -sfn -- "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock"; elif [ ! -S "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock" ]; then rm -f -- "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/app-server-control/forwarded-ssh-agent.sock"; fi && exec codex app-server proxy'
